query:
SELECT 
  'VENDA' as tipo,
  s.id,
  s.saleDate as data,
  s.finalAmount as valor
FROM sales s
JOIN partners p ON s.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Jackson%' AND s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'PAGAMENTO' as tipo,
  cp.id,
  cp.paidDate as data,
  cp.paidAmount as valor
FROM customerPayments cp
JOIN partners p ON cp.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Jackson%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'DEBITO' as tipo,
  cd.id,
  cd.debitDate as data,
  cd.debitAmount as valor
FROM customerDebits cd
JOIN partners p ON cd.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Jackson%'
ORDER BY data;
